Dear {!Case.Contact},
Thank you for submitting your inquiry. Case {!Case.CaseNumber}:{!Case.Subject} has been created and a representative will review and respond to you during business hours (8:00 AM EST - 5:00 PM EST or 8:00 AM BST - 5:00 PM BST), Monday through Friday.
We do our best to reply quickly and appreciate your patience.
Best Regards, Mosaic Customer Care
